mapper.sql: select id, batch_no, title, file_name, total_count, success_count, failed_count, waiting_count, import_time, create_time, update_time from tg_import_batch
mapper.select:
select b.id, b.batch_no, b.title, b.file_name, b.total_count, b.success_count, b.failed_count, b.waiting_count, b.import_time, b.create_time, b.update_time, (select count(*) from tg_telethon_account a where a.batch_no = b.batch_no and (a.is_deleted = 0 or a.is_deleted is null) and a.is_restricted = 1) as restricted_count, (select count(*) from tg_telethon_account a where a.batch_no = b.batch_no and (a.is_deleted = 0 or a.is_deleted is null) and a.is_frozen = 1) as frozen_count from tg_import_batch b
AND b.batch_no = #{batchNo}
AND b.file_name like concat('%', #{fileName}, '%')
order by b.id desc
mapper.insert: insert into tg_import_batch (batch_no, title, file_name, total_count, success_count, failed_count, waiting_count, import_time, create_time) values (#{batchNo}, #{title}, #{fileName}, #{totalCount}, #{successCount}, #{failedCount}, #{waitingCount}, #{importTime}, now())
mapper.delete:
delete from tg_import_batch where id in
#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE tg_import_batch b SET total_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tg_telethon_account a WHERE a.batch_no = b.batch_no AND (a.is_deleted = 0 OR a.is_deleted IS NULL)), success_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tg_telethon_account a WHERE a.batch_no = b.batch_no AND (a.is_deleted = 0 OR a.is_deleted IS NULL) AND a.status = 'online'), failed_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tg_telethon_account a WHERE a.batch_no = b.batch_no AND (a.is_deleted = 0 OR a.is_deleted IS NULL) AND a.status IN ('banned', 'failed')), waiting_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tg_telethon_account a WHERE a.batch_no = b.batch_no AND (a.is_deleted = 0 OR a.is_deleted IS NULL) AND a.status IN ('waiting', 'offline')), update_time = now()
